settings.displayPreferencesDesc: Set your preferred currency and language for the dashboard.

settings.languageHelp: Dashboard and UI text will display in this language.
settings.eventTogglesDesc: Choose which events to forward to your connected platforms.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Manage your subscription and plan.
billing.purchaseEventsNote: Only Purchase events count toward your limit. All other events are free and unlimited.
billing.purchasesPaused: Purchase events are no longer being forwarded to Meta. Upgrade to continue tracking orders.
billing.usedOfLimit: You've used {used} of {limit} orders. Upgrade to Starter ($29/mo) for 500 orders/month.
billing.autoUpgradeNotice: When you exceed {limit} orders, we'll automatically upgrade you to the next plan tier so your tracking stays uninterrupted.
billing.cancelNotice: Your subscription will cancel on {date}. You can reactivate it from the billing portal.
billing.faqWhatCountsAnswer: Only Purchase events count toward your order limit. All other events (PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout) are free and unlimited on every plan.
billing.faqExceedLimit: What happens when I exceed my order limit?
billing.faqExceedLimitAnswer: On paid plans, we automatically upgrade you to the next tier so your tracking stays uninterrupted. On the free plan, Purchase event forwarding is paused until you upgrade.
billing.faqChangePlansAnswer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time from the billing portal. Changes take effect immediately.
billing.faqRefundsAnswer: We do not offer refunds for partial months. You can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of your billing period.
billing.subscriptionSuccess: Thank you for subscribing! Your plan has been upgraded successfully. Enjoy your new features.
billing.checkoutCanceled: Checkout was canceled. No charges were made. You can subscribe anytime.
billing.failedCheckout: Failed to open checkout. Please try again.
billing.failedPortal: Failed to open billing portal. Please try again.
billing.autoUpgradeTo: Auto-upgrades to {plan} if you exceed {limit} orders
